name: documents-change-selection
description: Documents beside the chat, "Change this…" on a selection (31 Oct 2026): a packing list, then the person selects its Kitchen section in the panel and asks "Make this shorter: three items at most." — that section changes in the document (edit_document on its blocks with the rich tools; rewrite_section or edit_note with the simple ones), the other sections stay, never the chat and never a second document. The turn's `selection` selects the section as a drag over it on the page would. Fictional hills.

turns.user: Make me a packing list for a weekend of camping in the Hollow Hills, a fictional range, with sections for clothes, kitchen, sleeping and extras.
Make this shorter: three items at most.
